reviewMethod: Visually inspected all thirteen actual generated images side by side with approved pre-RH sources and available original model-home photographs. Additional full-resolution inspections of owners bedroom, bedroom2, bedroom5, loft and terrace; enlarged laundry lettering and bedside detail. All inspected images 2048 x 1360. Bed2 localized repair rechecked independently at full resolution after generation.
